svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 956 commits across five public projects, 70 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-19 through 2026-11-10 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-10T02:59:13.777Z.
